errors.description:
List of errors if the job is in the 'failing' or 'failed' state.
For more details recorded regarding workflow errors please refer to {@link InvalidationQueueErrorDetail}.  To get
additional details:
- Create a filter for the particular workflow of instance {@link InvalidationQueueFilterSpec}.
- Get a list of {@link InvalidationQueueError} by calling
```
queueErrList = WorkflowQueue.count(filter, false, true).errorSummary()
```
- For each error in queueErrList call err.detail() to get an instance of {@link InvalidationQueueErrorDetail}
which contains stack traces of the error in field errLog (among other information in other fields).

title: Status for the current run of a workflow.  JobStatus is the base status type for BatchJob and MapReduceJobs
name: Workflow.Status
